summary: The first entry on the Coast Path: a short stretch of stone wall at the harbour mouth, used here as a worked example of a seeded slot.

entry.location_note: Begins at the harbour car park and follows the wall east for roughly 400 metres.
what_to_look_for: Barnacle bands on the lower stonework, which mark the usual tide range.
Iron mooring rings set into the wall at irregular intervals.
Wind-shaped scrub on the landward side.
entry.accessibility: Level throughout; suitable for wheeled access as far as the beacon.
entry.takeaway: A good orientation stop before the rest of the group, since the whole bay is visible from the end of the wall.

notes: Fictional example content written for the Argus demo. Any resemblance to a real location is coincidental.
